metadata.question: Did Shanhai experience higher land surface temperature anomalies than Beijing during August 5-12, 2013 relative to the 2000-2012 average for that week?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) – MOD11A1 (Terra, daily, 1 km). - Date: focus on 5–12 Aug 2013 for the target week, and 2000–2012 for the climatology of the same calendar week (DOY 217–224). - Location: Two cities – Shanghai & Beijing – use a 20 km radius around city centres. 2. Masking strategy: - Use the QC band (LST_Day_1km_QC) to keep only good-quality LST pixels (flag 0 and 1). 3. Logic: - Build 2000-2012 climatology mean for 5–12 Aug. - Compute 2013 mean for 5–12 Aug. - Anomaly = 2013 mean – climatology mean. - Compare anomalies: Shanghai vs Beijing. - If any collection is empty → C1. - If after masking no valid pixels → C2. - If anomaly is None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise, print concise stats and answer A (Yes) or B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time sh = ee.Geometry.Point([121.47, 31.23]).buffer(20000) # Shanghai bj = ee.Geometry.Point([116.38, 39.90]).buffer(20000) # Beijing doy_start, doy_end = 217, 224 # 5-12 Aug def lst_anom(city, name): # 2000-2012 climatology base = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2000, 2012, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(doy_start, doy_end, 'day_of_year')) .select('LST_Day_1km')) if base.size().getInfo() == 0: print(f"{name} base empty") return None, None base = base.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QC_Day').lt(2))) baseMean = base.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15) # scale & K→C # 2013 target tgt = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate('2013-08-05', '2013-08-13') .select('LST_Day_1km')) if tgt.size().getInfo() == 0: print(f"{name} 2013 empty") return None, None tgt = tgt.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QC_Day').lt(2))) tgtMean = tgt.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15) # Anomaly anom = tgtMean.subtract(baseMean) # Stats cnt = anom.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=city, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if cnt == 0: print(f"{name} no valid pixels") return None, None val = anom.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=city, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() return val, cnt sh_anom, sh_n = lst_anom(sh, 'Shanghai') bj_anom, bj_n = lst_anom(bj, 'Beijing') if sh_anom is None or bj_anom is None: print("C1") else: print(f"Shanghai anomaly: {sh_anom:.2f}°C (pixels: {int(sh_n)})") print(f"Beijing anomaly: {bj_anom:.2f}°C (pixels: {int(bj_n)})") if sh_anom > bj_anom: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
sh = ee.Geometry.Point([121.47, 31.23]).buffer(20000)  # Shanghai
bj = ee.Geometry.Point([116.38, 39.90]).buffer(20000)  # Beijing
doy_start, doy_end = 217, 224  # 5-12 Aug

def lst_anom(city, name):
    # 2000-2012 climatology
    base = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')
              .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2000, 2012, 'year'))
              .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(doy_start, doy_end, 'day_of_year'))
              .select('LST_Day_1km'))
    if base.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print(f"{name} base empty")
        return None, None
    base = base.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QC_Day').lt(2)))
    baseMean = base.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)  # scale & K→C
    # 2013 target
    tgt = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')
             .filterDate('2013-08-05', '2013-08-13')
             .select('LST_Day_1km'))
    if tgt.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print(f"{name} 2013 empty")
        return None, None
    tgt = tgt.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QC_Day').lt(2)))
    tgtMean = tgt.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)
    # Anomaly
    anom = tgtMean.subtract(baseMean)
    # Stats
    cnt = anom.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=city, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    if cnt == 0:
        print(f"{name} no valid pixels")
        return None, None
    val = anom.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=city, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    return val, cnt

sh_anom, sh_n = lst_anom(sh, 'Shanghai')
bj_anom, bj_n = lst_anom(bj, 'Beijing')

if sh_anom is None or bj_anom is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Shanghai anomaly: {sh_anom:.2f}°C (pixels: {int(sh_n)})")
    print(f"Beijing anomaly: {bj_anom:.2f}°C (pixels: {int(bj_n)})")
    if sh_anom > bj_anom:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
